description.zh: 關子嶺岩場位於台南市白河區，是台灣南部著名的石灰岩攀岩場地。岩場以其獨特的石灰岩地形和知名的泥漿溫泉聞名。這裡的路線多為力量耐力型，難度偏高，適合有經驗的攀岩者。攀岩後可到附近享受獨特的泥漿溫泉。
description.text: Guanziling is located in Baihe District, Tainan City, and is a famous limestone climbing area in southern Taiwan. The crag is known for its unique limestone formations and the famous mud hot springs. Most routes here are power-endurance style with higher difficulty, suitable for experienced climbers. After climbing, enjoy the unique mud hot springs nearby.

liveVideoDescription.zh: 關子嶺周邊即時影像，可了解當地天氣狀況
liveVideoDescription.text: Live footage around Guanziling, useful for checking local weather conditions

transportation.zh: 從台南市區沿國道3號北上，接國道8號往白河方向，約50分鐘車程
transportation.text: From Tainan city, take Freeway 3 north, connect to Freeway 8 towards Baihe, about 50 minutes drive

transportation.zh: 搭乘新營客運往關子嶺方向，在關子嶺站下車
transportation.text: Take Xinying Bus towards Guanziling, get off at Guanziling stop

description.zh: 關子嶺的入口岩壁，10度外傾面，共有8條已開發路線。岩壁右側的大屋簷因風化嚴重尚無路線。
description.text: The gateway of the climbing area with a 10-degree overhanging face. There are 8 established routes. The big roof on the right side is seriously weathered with no routes.

description.zh: 因前方有一塊台灣形狀的石頭而得名。從集合場步道右轉可到達，高度約9公尺，路線多為純力量型。
description.text: Named by a Taiwan-shaped rock in front of the boulder. The boulder's height is only about 9 meters, so the routes here are almost pure power style.

description.zh: 進入木棧道即可看到，目前有3條Top-Rope路線，右側岩角及大外傾面尚待開發。
description.text: Visible when entering the wood railing. There are 3 established top-roping routes. The right arete and big overhanging face are still to be developed.

description.zh: 從終極岩步行約60公尺可到達，路線難度較為平均，「天天天藍」及「美人照鏡」為經典路線。
description.text: About 60 meters walk from Ultimate Wall. Routes here are simpler but still interesting. 'The Blue Sky' and 'The Beauty with a Mirror' are classic routes.

description.zh: 隱藏在叢林中的岩場，從集合場步行約2分鐘可到達。此區較為潮濕，蚊蟲多，建議攜帶防蚊液。
description.text: Hidden in the jungle, about 2 minutes walk from Assembling Field. This area is humid with many mosquitoes. Insect repellent is recommended.

description.zh: 關子嶺最新開發的區域，路線高度10-13公尺，多為力量耐力型路線。視野極佳，夏季也可攀登。
description.text: The latest opened area in Guanziling. Route heights range from 10 to 13 meters. Most are power-endurance routes. Great view and climbable even in summer.

description.zh: 在左側岩石上起攀，建議使用 Cheat Sticker 先讓腳踩穩一個洞，前三米較為死板。
description.text: Start on the rock on the left. It is recommended to use a Cheat Sticker and first get a foot planted firmly in a hole; the first three meters are rather stiff.

description.zh: 開始在終極岩左側第一個 Bolt 處，難關在岩壁中段，中段有 V3~V4 的抱石難度。
description.text: Starts at the first bolt on the left side of 終極岩. The crux is in the middle of the wall, where the difficulty is about V3-V4 bouldering.

description.zh: 使用「雪山飛狐」同樣的第一個 Bolt，難關在路線中間 V3~V4，後半段只有耐力問題。
description.text: Uses the same first bolt as「雪山飛狐」. The crux is V3-V4 in the middle of the route; the second half is only a matter of endurance.

description.zh: 終極岩最難的路線之一，結合力量與續航力之終極線。
description.text: One of the hardest routes at 終極岩; the ultimate line combining power and stamina.

description.zh: 力量耐力型路線。
description.text: A power-endurance route.

description.zh: 需要像青蛙一樣蹲低並抓遠點，力量耐力型路線。
description.text: You need to squat low like a frog and reach for distant holds; a power-endurance route.

description.zh: 終極岩最簡單的熱身路線，外傾動作多且有趣。如想架設 Top-Rope 可使用「終極右」。
description.text: The easiest warm-up route at 終極岩, with many fun overhanging moves. If you want to set up a top-rope, you can use「終極右」.

description.zh: 岩質不佳，可能是最容易崩岩的路線，有石灰岩點蝕特殊的紅白混合牆面。
description.text: The rock quality is poor; this may be the route most prone to rock breaking off. It has a distinctive red-and-white mixed wall surface from limestone pitting.

description.zh: 經典石灰岩路線，不太難，不會很酸，要注意岩邊較為鬆脫的手點。
description.text: A classic limestone route; not too hard and not very pumpy. Watch out for the rather loose handholds at the edge of the rock.

description.zh: 純力量型路線，可借助終極岩架設 Top-Rope。路線較短。
description.text: A pure power route; a top-rope can be set up by way of 終極岩. The route is rather short.

description.zh: 第一至第二個 Bolt 之後有點距離，建議使用 Cheat Sticker。短攀岩者推薦。
description.text: There is some distance after the first to second bolts; using a Cheat Sticker is recommended. Recommended for shorter climbers.

description.zh: 與「美人照鏡」共用上方兩個 Bolt 及 Anchors。難關在第二個 bolt 附近，是 5.12A 的入門線。
description.text: Shares the upper two bolts and the anchors with「美人照鏡」. The crux is near the second bolt; an entry-level 5.12a line.

description.zh: 集合場最經典的路線，持續的外傾動作會讓你完全 Pump。
description.text: The most classic route at 集合場; the sustained overhanging moves will leave you completely pumped.

description.zh: 難關在第三和第四個 Bolt 之間，有點距離略顯 runout 了一點。
description.text: The crux is between the third and fourth bolts; there is some distance, making it slightly runout.

description.zh: 集合場簡單的新手路線，適合初學者。
description.text: An easy novice route at 集合場; suitable for beginners.

description.zh: 集合場的簡單路線。
description.text: An easy route at 集合場.

description.zh: 需要很好的平衡技巧來克服第三個 Bolt 附近的難關。
description.text: Very good balance technique is needed to overcome the crux near the third bolt.

description.zh: 集合場新開發的簡單路線。
description.text: A newly developed easy route at 集合場.

description.zh: 純力量型路線，第一至三個 Bolt 處為岩角動作。
description.text: A pure power route; the first to third bolts involve arête moves.

description.zh: 因五彩繽紛的岩石會讓你找不到好的手點。
description.text: The multicolored rock will make it hard for you to find the good handholds.

description.zh: 動作不平衡，需要一氣呵成完攀。
description.text: The moves are off-balance; it needs to be climbed in one go.

description.zh: 難關在第一與第二個 Bolt 之間，左手指往一個小點，需要好的身體移動。
description.text: The crux is between the first and second bolts: the left-hand fingers go to a small hold, requiring good body movement.

description.zh: 從台灣島右側起攀，Drop Knee 後往左側迷宮，橫渡至左側台灣島，身高超過 175cm 的人有利。
description.text: Start on the right side of 台灣島, drop knee and head into the maze on the left, then traverse to 台灣島 on the left side. Climbers taller than 175 cm have an advantage.

description.zh: 從台灣島左側起攀，攀過大外傾面到第五個 Bolt，橫渡大陸第五個 Bolt。需要指力及腳法技巧。
description.text: Start on the left side of 台灣島, climb over the big overhanging face to the fifth bolt, then traverse to the fifth bolt of 大陸. Requires finger strength and footwork technique.

description.zh: 前四個 Bolt 與「環島旅行」相同。沿著岩邊往左上，攀到投奔大陸第五個 Bolt，需要指力。
description.text: The first four bolts are the same as「環島旅行」. Follow the edge of the rock up and left to the fifth bolt of 投奔大陸; requires finger strength.

description.zh: 與「環島旅行」起點相同，之後沿著 Ledge 往右攀登，需要很大的力量。
description.text: Same start as「環島旅行」, then climb right along the ledge; requires a great deal of power.

description.zh: 台灣島大石洞穴中，從右側的石頭坐下起攀，橫渡至左上。
description.text: In the cave of the 台灣島 boulder. Sit start from the rock on the right and traverse up and left.

description.zh: 神秘谷入口處路線，適合初學者。從左側裂隙起攀。
description.text: A route at the entrance of 神秘谷; suitable for beginners. Start from the crack on the left.

description.zh: 神秘谷入口的簡單路線。
description.text: An easy route at the entrance of 神秘谷.

description.zh: 可坐在大象耳朵上喝下午茶休息。與「左耳」共用同樣的固定點。
description.text: You can sit on the elephant's ear and rest over afternoon tea. Shares the same anchor with「左耳」.

description.zh: 與「右耳」共用同樣的固定點。路線起攀處有大象耳朵形狀的岩塊。
description.text: Shares the same anchor with「右耳」. There is a block shaped like an elephant's ear at the start of the route.

description.zh: 難關只有一步，使用單一手指口袋並試圖站起來，建議使用 Cheat Sticker。
description.text: The crux is a single move: using a mono pocket and trying to stand up. Using a Cheat Sticker is recommended.

description.zh: 從岩角處起攀，與「美人照鏡」共用同樣的固定點。
description.text: Start at the arête. Shares the same anchor with「美人照鏡」.

description.zh: 兩個手指口袋，注意腳步，有點滑。兩條路線共用同樣的固定點。
description.text: Two finger pockets; watch your footwork, it is a bit slippery. The two routes share the same anchor.

description.zh: 難關在第二和第三個 Bolt 之間，有 under-cling 動作，略顯 runout。
description.text: The crux is between the second and third bolts, with an undercling move; slightly runout.

description.zh: 路線名稱就是 PAIN。
description.text: The route name is simply PAIN.

description.zh: 路線名稱是 Fear，建議使用 Cheat Sticker。
description.text: The route name is Fear. Using a Cheat Sticker is recommended.

description.zh: 要注意第五和第六個 Bolt 之間的鬆岩。難關在5~6 Bolt 之間，需要做一些平衡動作。
description.text: Watch out for loose rock between the fifth and sixth bolts. The crux is between bolts 5 and 6 and requires some balance moves.

description.zh: 動作在第三個 Bolt 集中，頂部稍微再容易一些。力量風格路線，有很多小點和 open hold。
description.text: The moves are concentrated at the third bolt; the top is slightly easier. A power-style route with many small holds and open holds.

description.zh: 路線均勻，極度力量耐力型路線。單一動作難度不超過 V5，但你無法找到一個休息點。
description.text: The route is even throughout; an extreme power-endurance route. No single move is harder than V5, but you cannot find a single rest.

description.zh: 石灰岩點蝕特殊的紅白混合牆面，有小 edge、3~4 個 Bolt 力氣、V5 及 V4 的抱石區。
description.text: A distinctive red-and-white mixed wall surface from limestone pitting, with small edges, 3-4 bolts of power climbing, and V5 and V4 boulder sections.

description.zh: 從中央鐘乳石起攀上來，連續向上攀爬，每年蜜蜂會回來築巢。
description.text: Start up from the central stalactite and climb continuously upward. Bees return every year to build a nest.

description.zh: 從右側鐘乳石開始 Bolt，第四個 Bolt 後橫渡到石灰岩的左側。經典路線。
description.text: The bolts start from the stalactite on the right; after the fourth bolt, traverse to the left side of the limestone. A classic route.

description.zh: 毒刺林入口處的簡單路線之一。
description.text: One of the easy routes at the entrance of 毒刺林.

description.zh: 毒刺林入口處的簡單路線。
description.text: An easy route at the entrance of 毒刺林.

description.zh: 使用上方繩索架設 Top-Rope 系統。
description.text: Use the rope at the top to set up a top-rope system.

description.zh: 與「左手」共用同樣的固定點。
description.text: Shares the same anchor with「左手」.

description.zh: 與「右手」共用同樣的固定點。
description.text: Shares the same anchor with「右手」.
